description: npda-clinical.clinic_visits is the primary entity (one row per visit), joined to npda-demographics by NHS number. Demographics (A–E, M–N) and registration data (F–H, I–L) come from npda-demographics.patients and registrations. Visit date (O) comes from clinic_visits. Clinical measurements (P–T, AB–AL) are drawn from npda-clinical.measurements, selecting by measurement_type. Annual care-process dates and results (AE–AG, AM–AO, AS) come from npda-clinical.screening_results, selecting by screening_type. Treatment and technology snapshots (U–Z, AA, AN, AP) come from npda-clinical.technology. Psychology and dietetics (AU–AZ) come from npda-clinical.psychology. Hospital-admission details (BA–BG), smoking status (AQ–AR), sick-day rules (AT), and any values missing from structured fields are extracted from free-text clinical_notes and registration_notes.

identity.grain: one row per patient visit or appointment, including outpatient clinic visits, inpatient admissions and transition final visits
identity.patient_grain_rule: Patient-level attributes are joined via clinic_visits.patient_ref = patients.nhs_number; demographic and registration criteria are applied through an EXISTS or IN subquery over the anchor visit to avoid inflating the visit count.

fields.header: Has the patient had a diagnosis of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) or Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)?
Does the patient have a diagnosis of a learning disability?

fields.how_to_combine: Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'height' and units = 'cm' for the visit; if multiple, use the one recorded on the visit date.
Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'weight' and units = 'kg' for the visit.
Use measurements.measurement_date where measurement_type is 'height' or 'weight' for the visit; if both differ, use the date of the weight measurement or the single available date.

Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'hba1c' for the visit, respecting units ('%' or 'mmol/mol'). If the structured measurement is missing (e.g. capillary cartridge reading or offline machine), extract the value from clinical_notes.text.
Use measurements.measurement_date where measurement_type = 'hba1c'; if the value was extracted from clinical_notes, use the note_date.

fields.header: Insulin regime at time of visit
Other (non-insulin) blood glucose lowering medication at time of visit
Has lifestyle and dietary modification been recommended to reduce blood glucose levels?
Was the patient using a continuous glucose monitor (CGM) at time of visit?
Was the patient using (or trained to use) blood ketone testing equipment at time of visit?
Did the patient receive immunotherapy prior to or after the diagnosis of stage 3 Type 1 diabetes?

fields.how_to_combine: Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'systolic_bp' and units = 'mmHg' for the visit.
Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'diastolic_bp' and units = 'mmHg' for the visit.
Use measurements.measurement_date where measurement_type is 'systolic_bp' or 'diastolic_bp' for the visit.
Select screening_results.screening_date where screening_type = 'foot' for the patient in the audit year.
Select screening_results.screening_date where screening_type = 'retinal' for the patient in the audit year.
Select result_code where screening_type = 'retinal'. Map 'normal' to Normal and 'abnormal' to Abnormal. If result_code is blank (e.g. result awaited), derive from result_text or mark as Unknown.
Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'acr' and units = 'mg/mmol' for the visit.
Use measurements.measurement_date where measurement_type = 'acr' for the visit.
Derive the albuminuria stage from the ACR value and local laboratory reference ranges, or extract the stage from clinical_notes.text.
Select measurements.value where measurement_type = 'cholesterol' and units = 'mmol/l' for the visit.
Use measurements.measurement_date where measurement_type = 'cholesterol' for the visit.
Select screening_results.screening_date where screening_type = 'thyroid' for the patient in the audit year.

fields.header: At time of, or following measurement of thyroid function, was the patient prescribed any thyroid treatment?

fields.how_to_combine: Select screening_results.screening_date where screening_type = 'coeliac' for the patient in the audit year.

fields.header: Has the patient been recommended/prescribed a Gluten-free diet?
fields.how_to_combine: Infer from coeliac screening result_code ('positive' indicates coeliac disease and therefore GFD recommendation), coeliac_dietary_status result_code ('no' means no GFD), or free-text notes. Output 'Yes' if a GFD is documented, 'No' if explicitly absent, otherwise 'Unknown'.

fields.header: Does the patient smoke and/or vape?
fields.how_to_combine: Extract smoking and/or vaping status from free-text clinic letters and admission summaries.

fields.header: Date of offer of smoking cessation advice (if patient is a current smoker)
fields.how_to_combine: Extract the date smoking cessation advice was offered from free-text clinical notes; use the note_date if the exact advice date is not specified.

fields.header: Date that Influenza immunisation was recommended
fields.how_to_combine: Select screening_results.screening_date where screening_type = 'influenza_immunisation' for the patient in the audit year.

fields.header: Date of provision of advice ('sick-day rules') about managing diabetes during intercurrent illness or episodes of hyperglycaemia
fields.how_to_combine: Extract the date sick-day rules advice was provided from free-text clinical notes; use note_date if the specific advice date is not recorded.

fields.header: Date of Annual Psychological Screening Assessment
Following annual psychological screening, was the patient assessed as requiring additional psychological support outside of routine care?
Was the patient offered an additional appointment with a mental health professional as part of the diabetes MDT?
Date Level 3 carbohydrate counting education received
Was the patient offered an additional appointment with a paediatric dietitian during the audit year?
Date of additional appointment with dietitian

fields.how_to_combine: Extract the discharge date from free-text admission letters and summaries; use note_date as a fallback if the discharge date is not explicitly stated.
Categorise the reason for admission documented in free-text admission notes into the NPDA categories.

fields.header: Only complete if OTHER selected: Reason for admission (free text)
fields.how_to_combine: Extract the free-text reason for admission from clinical notes when the categorised reason is 'Other causes'.

fields.header: Only complete if DKA selected in previous question: During this DKA admission did the patient receive any of the following therapies?
fields.how_to_combine: Identify whether hypertonic saline, mannitol, bicarbonate infusion, or none were administered during the DKA admission from free-text admission summaries.
Extract the initial (first recorded) pH value from blood gas results documented in free-text admission letters and summaries.
Extract the initial standard bicarbonate value (mmol/l) from blood gas results documented in free-text admission letters and summaries.

cohort.from: clinic_visits b JOIN technology t ON b.patient_ref = t.patient_ref JOIN measurements m ON b.visit_id = m.visit_ref JOIN psychology p ON b.patient_ref = p.patient_ref JOIN screening_results s ON b.patient_ref = s.patient_ref

queries.sql: SELECT p.nhs_number, p.date_of_birth, p.postcode, p.sex_code, p.ethnicity_code, p.gp_practice_code, p.pdu_number FROM patients p WHERE p.nhs_number IN (:cohort)
SELECT c.visit_id, c.visit_date FROM clinic_visits c WHERE c.visit_id IN (:cohort)

SELECT t.visit_id, t.insulin_regimen, t.non_insulin_med, t.lifestyle_advice_given, t.cgm_in_use, t.blood_ketone_testing, t.immunotherapy_received, t.immunotherapy_start_date, t.thyroid_treatment FROM technology t WHERE t.visit_id IN (:cohort)

SELECT p.visit_id, p.screening_date, p.additional_support_needed, p.mental_health_appointment_status, p.carb_counting_education_date, p.dietitian_appointment_offered, p.dietitian_appointment_date FROM psychology p WHERE p.visit_id IN (:cohort)
SELECT m.visit_id, m.value, m.measurement_type, m.units, m.measurement_date FROM measurements m WHERE m.visit_id IN (:cohort)
SELECT c.visit_id, c.text, c.note_date FROM clinical_notes c WHERE c.visit_id IN (:cohort)
SELECT s.visit_id, s.screening_date, s.screening_type, s.result_code, s.result_text FROM screening_results s WHERE s.visit_id IN (:cohort)
